entries.name: orca

why.zh: 「stablyai/orca」属于框架 / SDK，可把 Agent 能力集成进自研产品或工作流；聚焦 ade、Agent IDE、AI Agent、Claude Code 等方向；主要使用 TypeScript。
why.en: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime. A Framework / SDK project for embedding agent capabilities into your own product or workflow, mainly written in TypeScript, focused on ade, Agent IDE, AI Agents, Claude Code.
